purpose: Verify employee can apply for an eligible leave category according to role/category policy
preconditions: Active faculty member with configured leave entitlement parameters
action_or_input: Submit leave request for Casual Leave (CL)
expected_result: Leave request passes category validation successfully

purpose: Verify employee cannot apply for a leave category not permitted for their employee class
preconditions: Staff employee (non-faculty) who does not get Vacation Leave (VL)
action_or_input: Submit leave request for Vacation Leave (VL)
expected_result: Request is rejected with 422 Unprocessable Entity due to category ineligibility

purpose: Verify CL request within entitlement is permitted
preconditions: Employee has 8 days CL balance
expected_result: Application accepted and balance validated

purpose: Verify CL request exceeding available balance is refused
preconditions: Employee has 1 day CL balance
expected_result: Request refused with 422 Unprocessable Entity due to insufficient balance

purpose: Verify uncredited/remaining CL lapses at calendar year end without carry-forward
preconditions: Employee has remaining CL balance at end of calendar year
expected_result: Remaining CL balance lapses to 0 and does not carry forward into next calendar year

purpose: Verify RH can only be taken on dates listed in the published RH calendar up to limit (2 days/year)
preconditions: Calendar year has published RH list; employee has taken 0 RH days
action_or_input: Apply for RH on a published RH date
expected_result: Application accepted and validated against published RH calendar

purpose: Verify RH requested on non-published date is refused
preconditions: Requested date is not in published RH list
action_or_input: Apply for RH on an unlisted date
expected_result: Request refused with 422 Unprocessable Entity

purpose: Verify RH request exceeding annual max of 2 days is refused
preconditions: Employee has already utilized 2 RH days in current calendar year
expected_result: Request refused with 422 Unprocessable Entity due to RH quota exhaustion

purpose: Verify Special Casual Leave (SCL) application within annual 15-day limit with valid admissible purpose
preconditions: Employee has 15 days SCL remaining and valid conference/academic duty reason
action_or_input: Apply for 3 days SCL with supported academic purpose
expected_result: Request accepted for processing

purpose: Verify SCL exceeding 15 days in calendar year is rejected
preconditions: Employee has 2 days SCL remaining
expected_result: Request refused with 422 Unprocessable Entity

purpose: Verify Earned Leave (EL) carries forward up to maximum accumulation limit (300 days)
preconditions: Staff employee has 295 days EL balance; 15 days credited at semi-annual credit
expected_result: Balance is capped at 300 days; excess days do not accumulate beyond 300

purpose: Verify faculty Vacation Leave (VL) can only be availed during notified Academic Vacation periods
preconditions: Date is within notified Academic Vacation period
action_or_input: Faculty applies for VL within vacation dates
expected_result: Request accepted

purpose: Verify faculty VL applied outside notified vacation period is rejected
preconditions: Date is during academic semester (outside notified vacation period)
expected_result: Request refused with 422 Unprocessable Entity

purpose: Verify unavailed VL converts to EL at 2:1 ratio for faculty preventing forfeiture
preconditions: Faculty has 10 unavailed VL days at calendar year-end
expected_result: 5 days added to EL balance (10 / 2 = 5 EL days credited)

purpose: Verify EL credited from VL conversion is subject to overall 300-day cap
preconditions: Faculty EL balance is 298 days; 10 unavailed VL days (5 EL days equivalent)
expected_result: EL balance becomes 300 days max; remaining 3 days overflow/capped

purpose: Verify Commuted Leave (COL) debits Half Pay Leave at 2:1 ratio and requires medical certificate
preconditions: Employee applies for 5 days Commuted Leave with medical certificate uploaded
expected_result: Request accepted, 10 days debited from Half Pay Leave / COL entitlement

purpose: Verify Commuted Leave without medical certificate is refused
preconditions: Employee applies for COL without medical certificate
action_or_input: Submit COL request without document attachment
expected_result: Request refused with 422 Unprocessable Entity

purpose: Verify CL can be taken as 0.5 day for first-half or second-half
preconditions: Employee has sufficient CL balance
action_or_input: Apply for half-day CL for first-half (FN)
expected_result: Chargeable duration is calculated exactly as 0.5 days

purpose: Verify half-day is prohibited for non-CL categories (EL, SCL, COL, VL)
preconditions: Employee applies for EL
expected_result: Request refused with 422 Unprocessable Entity

purpose: Verify intervening weekends/holidays are included in chargeable days for EL, COL, and VL
preconditions: Friday to Monday requested period with weekend in between (2 working days, 2 weekend days)
action_or_input: Calculate duration for EL from Friday to Monday
expected_result: Duration is calculated as 4 continuous days

purpose: Verify intervening weekends/holidays are excluded for CL and SCL
preconditions: Friday to Monday requested period with Saturday and Sunday as weekend
action_or_input: Calculate duration for CL from Friday to Monday
expected_result: Duration is calculated as 2 working days

purpose: Verify new leave request overlapping with active pending/approved leave is blocked
preconditions: Employee has approved leave from 2026-12-10 to 2026-12-15
expected_result: Request refused with 422 Unprocessable Entity due to overlapping leave

purpose: Verify first-half and second-half CL on the same date do not overlap and can coexist
preconditions: Employee has approved half-day CL on 2026-12-10 FN (morning session)
action_or_input: Apply for half-day CL on 2026-12-10 AN (afternoon session)
expected_result: Request passes overlap validation and is accepted

purpose: Verify Station Leave information is coupled to the leave request and does not form independent lifecycle
preconditions: Employee applying for leave with outstation travel
action_or_input: Submit leave application with station leave details (destination, emergency contact, dates)
expected_result: Station leave captured inside the single leave application without separate request ID

purpose: Verify nominated substitute is eligible (active employee, distinct from applicant, not on leave)
preconditions: Substitute is active employee in same/compatible unit and not on leave
action_or_input: Nominate valid substitute in leave application
expected_result: Nomination accepted

purpose: Verify applicant cannot nominate themselves as substitute
preconditions: Applicant attempts to select their own user ID as substitute
action_or_input: Submit leave application with applicant as substitute
expected_result: Request refused with 422 Unprocessable Entity

purpose: Verify request does not advance to Unit Head review until substitute gives consent
preconditions: Leave application submitted with nominated substitute
action_or_input: Check request state prior to substitute response
expected_result: Request remains in PENDING_SUBSTITUTE state; Unit Head cannot act

purpose: Verify when substitute declines, applicant can nominate a replacement substitute
preconditions: Request in PENDING_SUBSTITUTE; substitute declines nomination
expected_result: Request updates substitute and re-enters PENDING_SUBSTITUTE for new nominee

purpose: Verify Unit Head decision is final sanctioning authority for CL and RH
preconditions: Request for CL approved by substitute and routed to Unit Head
expected_result: Request status transitions directly to SANCTIONED/APPROVED without higher routing

purpose: Verify Unit Head review of EL/COL/VL/SCL is recommendation and routes to higher sanctioning authority
preconditions: Request for EL with substitute consent at Unit Head review
expected_result: Request status transitions to RECOMMENDED / PENDING_HIGHER_SANCTION

purpose: Verify higher-sanction request reaches designated competent authority (Dean/Director)
preconditions: Request recommended by Unit Head
expected_result: Request transitions to SANCTIONED/APPROVED and balance is debited

purpose: Verify administrative establishment verification step can verify leave admissibility before final sanction
preconditions: Higher sanction leave requires establishment admissibility check
expected_result: Admissibility record logged in action history

purpose: Verify Director leave request is auto-sanctioned / self-sanctioned without routing to subordinate
preconditions: Applicant holds Director role
expected_result: Request is self-sanctioned without requiring Unit Head approval

purpose: Verify applicant can immediately withdraw a pending request prior to final sanction
preconditions: Leave request in PENDING_SUBSTITUTE or PENDING_APPROVAL
expected_result: Request status immediately transitions to WITHDRAWN; pending debit is released

purpose: Verify withdrawal is rejected once leave is already approved/sanctioned
preconditions: Leave request in SANCTIONED/APPROVED state
expected_result: Request refused with 422 Unprocessable Entity (cancellation must be used instead)

purpose: Verify approved leave can be cancelled before its start date with sanctioning authority approval
preconditions: Leave is SANCTIONED, start date is in the future
action_or_input: Applicant requests cancellation before start date
expected_result: Cancellation recorded and leave balance restored upon approval

purpose: Verify cancellation is prohibited after leave start date has passed
preconditions: Leave start date is in the past
expected_result: Request refused with 422 Unprocessable Entity (resumption/early resumption must be used)

purpose: Verify employee can submit a fresh application for identical or overlapping dates once earlier leave is cancelled
preconditions: Earlier leave request was fully CANCELLED and balance restored
action_or_input: Submit fresh leave application covering same dates
expected_result: Application succeeds without overlap error

purpose: Verify extension of ongoing EL/COL/VL submitted before end of current leave period
preconditions: Employee currently on approved EL
action_or_input: Submit extension request before ongoing leave expires
expected_result: Extension created and routed through approval chain

purpose: Verify extension workflow is prohibited for CL and RH
preconditions: Employee has approved CL
expected_result: Request refused with 422 Unprocessable Entity

purpose: Verify duty resumption report submitted upon return from leave
preconditions: Employee returns from sanctioned long leave (EL/COL/VL)
action_or_input: Submit resumption report with joining date and session
expected_result: Resumption report created and pending Unit Head verification

purpose: Verify early resumption credits back unavailed leave days to employee balance upon approval
preconditions: Sanctioned leave was for 10 days; employee resumes duty 3 days early
expected_result: Leave record end date adjusted and 3 days credited back to leave balance

purpose: Verify late resumption flags overdue period for regularization
preconditions: Employee resumes duty 2 days after sanctioned leave end date
expected_result: Resumption flags late reporting and requires regularization

purpose: Verify Admin/Establishment can record offline-sanctioned leave with retrospective adjustment
preconditions: Authorized Admin user records offline sanction paper approval
action_or_input: Post offline sanction record with reference number and approver details
expected_result: Leave ledger synchronized, balance debited, audit trail recorded

purpose: Verify policy validations evaluate against current active configuration parameters
preconditions: Max consecutive CL configured as 3 days
expected_result: Request rejected due to exceeding current consecutive CL limit

purpose: Verify gazetted holidays and restricted holidays take effect according to published calendar
preconditions: Institute publishes annual holiday calendar
action_or_input: Validate holiday counting for date matching gazetted holiday
expected_result: Date identified as holiday and excluded from working-day leave count

purpose: Verify SLA reminder notification generated when pending review exceeds reminder threshold
preconditions: Task has been pending review beyond reminder SLA threshold hours
expected_result: Reminder notification logged/sent to current pending assignee

purpose: Verify SLA escalation notification generated when pending review exceeds escalation threshold
preconditions: Task has been pending review beyond escalation SLA threshold hours
expected_result: Escalation notification logged/sent to higher authority

purpose: Verify in-place modification of submitted leave request is strictly prohibited
preconditions: Leave request has been submitted and has ID
action_or_input: Attempt PUT/PATCH to modify leave dates or category
expected_result: Request refused with 405 Method Not Allowed or 422 Unprocessable Entity (must withdraw and resubmit)

purpose: Verify action notification is dispatched whenever a pending task is assigned to an actor
preconditions: Leave request routed to Unit Head
expected_result: Task assignment event recorded for Unit Head

purpose: Verify unauthorized user cannot approve or sanction leave requests
preconditions: Standard employee without Unit Head role
action_or_input: Attempt to approve leave request at Unit Head approval endpoint
expected_result: Request refused with 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify Admin configuration maintenance cannot sanction or alter individual leave decisions
preconditions: Admin user without sanctioning delegation
action_or_input: Attempt to sanction pending leave request directly through admin panel
expected_result: Request refused with 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify admin can update SLA reminder and escalation threshold hours
preconditions: Authorized Admin user updates SLA config
action_or_input: Set reminder threshold to 48 hours and escalation threshold to 96 hours
expected_result: Configuration updated and applied to subsequent SLA calculations
